protocol.task: H/A possession conditional on supplied game state; no dead-ball training
protocol.selection_metric: mean official spellF1 with oracle game-state gate on external validation modes
protocol.symmetry: team swap complements probabilities; player slot order and field reflections preserve predictions
protocol.ball_smoothing: gaussian sigma 6 frames inside visible runs, all modes (augmentation.smooth_ball)

temporal_cnn.input: the same per-frame features as the trees, standardised
temporal_cnn.selection: mean official spellF1 with oracle game state on the validation modes, every frame at 25 Hz, against the best tree model measured the same way

config.input: the same per-frame features as the trees, standardised
config.selection: mean official spellF1 with oracle game state on the validation modes, every frame at 25 Hz, against the best tree model measured the same way

temporal_cnn.reproducibility: weights depend on the PyTorch build and thread count; the exported JSON is what the pipeline runs
